'''Jaipan Industries Limited''' is Indian home appliances company based in [[Mumbai]], [[Maharashtra]], [[India]]. It manufactures and markets various Home Appliances and Non stick cookware's under the brand name of Jaipan.<ref>{{cite web |author=Shrutika |url=http://www.indiaprwire.com/pressrelease/consumer/2010032946804.htm |title=Home appliances and Consumer Durable Jaipan Industries enters for the first time into lighting's and Fitting's |publisher=Indiaprwire.com |date=2010-03-29 |accessdate=2010-12-21 |archive-date=10 March 2012 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120310153822/http://www.indiaprwire.com/pressrelease/consumer/2010032946804.htm |url-status=dead }}</ref> It is also manufactures of consumer durable products and Mobile handsets.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/news-by-industry/cons-products/durables/Jaipan-forays-into-mobile-handset-business/articleshow/6763091.cms |title=Jaipan forays into mobile handset business – The Economic Times |publisher=Economictimes.indiatimes.com |date=2010-10-17 |accessdate=2010-12-21}}</ref> It also markets its products in a number of countries like Sri Lanka, Mauritius, Bangladesh, Nepal, U.A.E.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.jaipanonline.com/Information/AboutUs.aspx |title=Jaipan |publisher=Jaipanonline.com |date= |accessdate=2010-12-21}}</ref> It has more than 140 products, 125 distributors and more than 6000 dealers across [[India]]. Its products include [[food processor]]s, [[Mixer (cooking)|mixer]]s, [[juicer]]s, hand mixers, [[blender]]s, [[Clothes iron|iron]]s, [[sandwich toaster]]s, [[pop-up toaster]]s, roti makers, [[mechanical fan]]s, [[home cinema|home theatre]]s, [[gas heater]]s, [[gas burner]]s, [[water purifier]]s, [[vacuum cleaner]]s, [[tea kettle]]s, [[rice cooker]]s, [[dutch oven]]s, [[oven]]s, stainless cutlery and dinnersets.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.businessindex.com.ng/companyprofile.aspx?mfgcode=50636107 |title=Company Profile – JAIPAN INDUSTRIES LTD |publisher=Businessindex.com.ng |date= |accessdate=2010-12-21 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110724143228/http://www.businessindex.com.ng/companyprofile.aspx?mfgcode=50636107 |archive-date=24 July 2011 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

extract: Jaipan Industries Limited is Indian home appliances company based in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. It manufactures and markets various Home Appliances and Non stick cookware's under the brand name of Jaipan. It is also manufactures of consumer durable products and Mobile handsets. It also markets its products in a number of countries like Sri Lanka, Mauritius, Bangladesh, Nepal, U.A.E. It has more than 140 products, 125 distributors and more than 6000 dealers across India. Its products include food processors, mixers, juicers, hand mixers, blenders, irons, sandwich toasters, pop-up toasters, roti makers, mechanical fans, home theatres, gas heaters, gas burners, water purifiers, vacuum cleaners, tea kettles, rice cookers, dutch ovens, ovens, stainless cutlery and dinnersets.
